vocab.def: to achieve what you are trying to achieve
the result when someone achieves what they wanted
a time when someone or something does not succeed
to create something for the first time
something that has been created for the first time
a person who creates something for the first time
to find something for the first time
something that someone finds for the first time
to make something by putting parts together
to build something large such as a bridge or building
to think about and decide what you will do

sentences.text: Many inventors try many times before they succeed.
sentences.l1: Nhiều nhà phát minh thử nhiều lần trước khi họ thành công.

sentences.text: If you work hard, you can succeed.
sentences.l1: Nếu bạn làm việc chăm chỉ, bạn có thể thành công.

sentences.text: Success often comes after many failures.
sentences.l1: Thành công thường đến sau nhiều thất bại.

sentences.text: The light bulb was a great success.
sentences.l1: Bóng đèn là một thành công lớn.

sentences.text: Inventors sometimes fail before they succeed.
sentences.l1: Các nhà phát minh đôi khi thất bại trước khi thành công.

sentences.text: If the first plan does not work, try again. Do not fail and stop.
sentences.l1: Nếu kế hoạch đầu tiên không hiệu quả, hãy thử lại. Đừng thất bại rồi dừng lại.

sentences.text: Failure can help inventors learn.
sentences.l1: Thất bại có thể giúp các nhà phát minh học hỏi.

sentences.text: The first trial was a failure, but the second one worked.
sentences.l1: Lần thử đầu tiên thất bại, nhưng lần thứ hai thành công.

sentences.text: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone.
sentences.l1: Alexander Graham Bell đã phát minh ra điện thoại.

sentences.text: Valerie Thomas invented technology for 3D movies.
sentences.l1: Valerie Thomas đã phát minh công nghệ cho phim 3D.

sentences.text: The telephone was an important invention.
sentences.l1: Điện thoại là một phát minh quan trọng.

sentences.text: An invention is something created for the first time.
sentences.l1: Một phát minh là thứ được tạo ra lần đầu tiên.

sentences.text: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
sentences.l1: Thomas Edison là một nhà phát minh nổi tiếng.

sentences.text: An inventor creates new things.
sentences.l1: Một nhà phát minh tạo ra những thứ mới.

sentences.text: Columbus discovered America.
sentences.l1: Columbus đã phát hiện ra châu Mỹ.

sentences.text: Marie Curie discovered radiation.
sentences.l1: Marie Curie đã phát hiện ra phóng xạ.

sentences.text: The discovery of radiation changed science.
sentences.l1: Sự phát hiện ra phóng xạ đã thay đổi khoa học.

sentences.text: A discovery is something people find for the first time.
sentences.l1: Một sự phát hiện là thứ con người tìm thấy lần đầu tiên.

sentences.text: Construction workers built the Golden Gate Bridge.
sentences.l1: Công nhân xây dựng đã xây cầu Golden Gate.

sentences.text: Builders build houses, bridges, and schools.
sentences.l1: Thợ xây xây nhà, cầu và trường học.

sentences.text: Workers constructed the bridge many years ago.
sentences.l1: Công nhân đã xây cây cầu nhiều năm trước.

sentences.text: To construct means to build something large.
sentences.l1: Construct nghĩa là xây dựng một thứ lớn.

sentences.text: Good inventors plan their work carefully.
sentences.l1: Những nhà phát minh giỏi lên kế hoạch công việc cẩn thận.

sentences.text: A plan helps people decide what to do next.
sentences.l1: Một kế hoạch giúp mọi người quyết định làm gì tiếp theo.

sentences.text: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
sentences.l1: Điện thoại được phát minh bởi Alexander Graham Bell.

sentences.text: Radiation was discovered by Marie Curie.
sentences.l1: Phóng xạ được phát hiện bởi Marie Curie.

sentences.text: The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison.
sentences.l1: Bóng đèn được phát minh bởi Thomas Edison.

sentences.text: Technology for 3D movies was invented by Valerie Thomas.
sentences.l1: Công nghệ cho phim 3D được phát minh bởi Valerie Thomas.

sentences.text: Before antibiotics were invented, infections could be very dangerous.
sentences.l1: Trước khi thuốc kháng sinh được phát minh, nhiễm trùng có thể rất nguy hiểm.

sentences.text: Before X-rays were invented, doctors had to perform surgery to see inside someone.
sentences.l1: Trước khi tia X được phát minh, bác sĩ phải phẫu thuật để nhìn bên trong cơ thể ai đó.

repair.broken: The telephone invented by Alexander Graham Bell.

errors.explanation: Use was + past participle for the past passive.

a: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.

repair.broken: Radiation was discover by Marie Curie.

errors.explanation: Use the past participle after was in the passive.

a: Radiation was discovered by Marie Curie.

repair.broken: The light bulb was invented Thomas Edison.

errors.explanation: Use by before the agent in passive sentences.

a: The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison.

repair.broken: Before antibiotics invented, infections could be very dangerous.

errors.explanation: Use were + past participle for plural passive subjects.

a: Before antibiotics were invented, infections could be very dangerous.

repair.broken: Construction workers build the Golden Gate Bridge.

errors.explanation: Use past simple for a completed past action.

a: Construction workers built the Golden Gate Bridge.

transform.broken: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone.
a: The telephone was invented by Alexander Graham Bell.
transform.explanation: Move the object to the front and use was + past participle + by.

a: Radiation was discovered by Marie Curie.
transform.explanation: Use was discovered by for a past discovery.

transform.broken: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
a: The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison.
transform.explanation: Use was invented by for a past invention.

transform.broken: Valerie Thomas invented technology for 3D movies.
a: Technology for 3D movies was invented by Valerie Thomas.
transform.explanation: Use was invented by for a singular uncountable subject like technology.
